title: ISO Doesn't Create Noise. Set It Last.
excerpt: The grain in your high-ISO photos doesn't come from the ISO dial. It comes from too little light reaching the sensor, and underexposing to protect a low ISO makes it worse. Set shutter and aperture first, and let ISO land where the exposure needs it.

title: Three-Year-Old Cameras Are Outselling the New Ones
excerpt: October's best-selling mirrorless cameras in Japan are three years old. The Sony A7C II and A6700 outsold every 2026 launch, and a 2022 Canon tied the brand-new R8 Mark II. Buyers are voting for cameras they can carry, not spec sheets.

title: What the Year's Best Nature Photos Have in Common
excerpt: The year's best nature photographs were chosen from 27,108 entries, and the overall winner is a water lily leaf and its ice replica, shot a short walk from the photographer's home. The winning thread is not rare gear or rare animals. It is patience and attention.
